sanskrit_verse: ekaikaḥ punar eteṣāṃ kriyābhedāt prabhidyate // Brh_1,15.5
sph_interpretive_translation: Each individual, through differentiation of action, becomes distinct again.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from differentiated capacity, not uniform status.
Causation arises through volitional action and its conscious differentiation.
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by the ability to sustain differentiated action.
Restoration occurs when consciousness realigns with its inherent capacity for differentiation.
Consciousness alignment is achieved through recognition of one's own action-differentiation.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs differentiated action THEN assign capacity-based role accordingly.
IF consciousness misaligns due to unowned action THEN initiate restoration protocol via self-recognition.
IF differentiation collapses into uniformity THEN enforce re-differentiation through completion process.
IF agent denies capacity THEN invoke integrity reintegration until ownership is restored.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that individual capacity — revealed through differentiated action — determines rightful authority and responsibility. Uniform application of law without regard to volitional differentiation violates Dharma. The court must recognize and restore such differentiations as foundational to justice.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that differentiation emerges through kriyā-bheda. Responsibility aligns sequentially (anupūrvaśaḥ) with the agent’s capacity to sustain such action. There is no punitive element; only restoration of rightful consciousness-differentiation.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate self-recognition protocol to restore ownership of action-differentiation.
Deploy capacity-realignment process until integrity of role-assumption is restored.
Enforce sequential completion of fragmented actions to reintegrate consciousness.
Apply non-coercive witnessing mechanism to dissolve denial of capacity.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This verse affirms that consciousness, through action-differentiation, reasserts its unique capacity. Justice is restoration. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
